# nuthatch nest on arbitrum-one

A self-hosted blockchain index. Query it locally; there is no third-party API.

## Contracts
- `board` = 0x5f04b3aa9ba68db285a7216bdeb6efa9beb59962

## Tables (one per contract event, plus any `[extract]` table)
- `board__bounty_cancelled` - BountyCancelled(uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, bountyId, amount)
- `board__bounty_distributed` - BountyDistributed(uint256,address,address,address,uint256,address) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, bountyId, indexer, allocationId, payee, amount, caller)
- `board__bounty_posted` - BountyPosted(uint256,address,bytes32,uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, bountyId, developer, deploymentId, amount, expiresAt)
- `board__bounty_refunded` - BountyRefunded(uint256,uint256) (block_number, block_hash, block_timestamp, tx_hash, log_index, address, _seq, bountyId, amount)

## SQL types
- `uint`/`int` columns wider than 64 bits are exact decimal text: never `SUM` the raw column.
  `<col>_dec` is the value as `DECIMAL(38,0)`, NULL when it does not fit (`<col>_overflow` is
  then true). Ids, nonces and hashes stay on the raw column.
- `bool` columns are text `'true'`/`'false'`: write `col = 'true'` or `CAST(col AS BOOLEAN)`.
- Reserved-word columns such as `"from"` and `"to"` must be double-quoted.
- Call the MCP `schema` tool first: it lists the `_dec`, bool and reserved columns.

## Live HTTP API (run `nuthatch dev`)
- `GET /`                    index status
- `GET /tables`              every table with its columns
- `GET /table/{name}?limit=N` recent rows of one table (hot + sealed)
- `GET /entity/{id}`         one row by id (`{block:012}-{logindex:06}`)
- `GET /sql?q=SELECT...`     read-only SQL; each table is a view named `{alias}__{event}`, and each
                             authored view (`views/*.sql`) answers by its own name
- `GET /balances?limit=N`    top holder balances (when an ERC-20 Transfer table is present)
- `GET /balance/{address}`   one address's derived balance
- `GET /queries`             the mount's SQL mode and the queries its operator declared in
                             `mounts.toml` (none on an open nest); `GET /q/{name}` runs one
- `GET /derived`             the nest's incremental entities (`entities.toml`); `GET /derived/{entity}` reads one
- `GET /diff?from=X&to=Y`    what happened in a range (`block=N`, or `tx=0x..&block=N`), as JSON, `format=text` or `markdown`

## MCP (for coding agents)
Run `nuthatch mcp` (stdio) to expose tools: status, schema, tables, table, sql, entity, diff,
balance, top_balances. Fully offline against the local instance; nothing phones home.
